question.prompt: Which piece of information below is stated in Text 2 but is NOT mentioned anywhere in Text 1?

stimulus.title: Two Notes About the Excursion
stimulus.body: Text 1 — From the class newsletter: 'Next Tuesday, Year 5 will travel to the Riverside Wildlife Centre. Students must wear full school uniform, bring a labelled water bottle, and arrive at school by 8:15 am sharp, as the bus departs at 8:30 am. Please pack a nut-free lunch, since the centre has a strict allergy policy.' Text 2 — From a note sent home by Ms Whitlock: 'A reminder that our wildlife centre excursion is happening soon. Please make sure your child has closed-in shoes, since parts of the reserve are quite muddy at this time of year, and a labelled water bottle. Morning tea will be provided by the centre, so students do not need to bring their own.'

options.text: That parts of the reserve are muddy.
The exact time the bus departs.
The need to bring a labelled water bottle.
That students must wear full school uniform.

question.explanation: The mud warning appears only in Text 2, in the sentence about closed-in shoes. The bus departure time and the uniform requirement are both stated only in Text 1, and the water bottle requirement is repeated in both texts. Comparing both texts carefully shows the mud warning is the only option genuinely unique to Text 2. So the mud warning is the piece of information stated in Text 2 but absent from Text 1.

metadata.subject: reading
metadata.skill: Comparing information across two short texts
